_help: Edited by hand when news breaks; the collector never touches it. 'copyable' turns true once there's a public way to copy (dump) GTA 6 off a PS5, which emulators need before anyone can test it. 'routes' lists every way to get GTA 6 onto a PC (status: works, partial or blocked), 'players' the people and groups involved, and 'timeline' the dated events that got here, newest first. Keep every claim sourced, say 'reported' for anything Rockstar or Sony hasn't confirmed, and never link to exploits, payloads, jailbreak tools or game files: cite news coverage instead.
copy_blocker: GTA 6 needs PS5 firmware 14.23, which Sony released on November 17, and there's no public way to copy games off a PS5 on any 14.xx firmware: public exploits stop at 13.60. Days before launch the PS5 hacker Gezine said he had dumped an unnamed game on 14.22, one version older, but he hasn't shown proof or shared how.
firmware: Sony confirmed that GTA 6 needs PS5 system software 26.07-14.23.00, released on November 17, 2026; its notes list only security fixes. The pre-load package had listed 14.22, and earlier builds 14.10.
pc_version: Rockstar hadn't announced a PC version by launch day. GamesBeat reports one for early 2027, citing four industry sources.

routes.title: Remote Play from your own console
routes.label: Works today
routes.text: Rockstar says GTA 6 "will also fully support Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox". With your own PS5 or Xbox Series X|S and a copy of the game, Sony's PS Remote Play app, the Xbox app or the open-source chiaki-ng client streams it to a Windows PC. The game still runs on the console, at its 30 fps, with some added input delay from the stream.

source.name: GamingBolt: GTA 6 supports Xbox Cloud Gaming and Remote Play

routes.title: Remote Play with frame generation
routes.label: Works, with lag
routes.text: Two free PC tools add AI-generated frames on your graphics card. SmoovPlay, built on chiaki-ng, turns a 30 fps Remote Play stream into 60 to 120 fps for roughly 20 to 36 ms of extra delay; Veyra does the same to a capture-card or Remote Play feed and adds upscaling. The game still responds like 30 fps, and both GTA 6 demos so far used Rockstar's trailer, not the game running on a console.

source.name: TweakTown: SmoovPlay turns 30 fps console streams into 120 fps

routes.title: Cloud streaming
routes.label: Xbox consoles only
routes.text: Rockstar's November 10 announcement puts GTA 6 on Xbox Cloud Gaming for Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One only. Xbox's chief strategy officer, Matthew Ball, said it won't stream to PC. It isn't on GeForce Now or PlayStation Plus cloud streaming either.

source.name: Shacknews: Xbox clarifies GTA 6 won't stream on PC

routes.title: An official PC version
routes.label: Not announced
routes.text: Rockstar hadn't announced one by launch day, and Take-Two's CEO, Strauss Zelnick, says that news will come from Rockstar. GamesBeat reported on October 13 that a PC version is planned for early 2027, citing four industry sources. GTA V took about 19 months to reach PC, and Red Dead Redemption 2 about a year. Tech analysts expect even a PC version to need a top-end processor for 60 fps.

source.name: Insider Gaming: GTA 6 PC news will come from Rockstar, says Take-Two

routes.title: PS5 emulation
routes.label: Needs a copy first
routes.text: AnyPS5, KytyPS5 and SharpEmu can only test games copied (dumped) off a PS5, and nobody can copy GTA 6 yet: it needs firmware 14.23, and public exploits stop at 13.60. GTA V's PS5 version, on the same RAGE engine, shows how close the tools are: on November 17 a tester combining AnyPS5 with KytyPS5's graphics code drove around Los Santos at a locked 60 fps on a mid-range PC, with graphics bugs.

source.name: TweakTown: GTA V's PS5 version runs at 60 fps on PC with an RX 6750 XT

routes.title: A fan-made native port
routes.label: Needs a copy first
routes.text: Since October, fans have rebuilt PlayStation games to run natively on PC: Bloodborne on October 1, then on November 13 Astro Bot, the first PS5 exclusive, built on AnyPS5 and KytyPS5. Each needs a copy dumped off the player's own console, so GTA 6 would need the same dump. Take-Two has also fought fan rebuilds before: it had re3 and reVC, rebuilds of GTA III and Vice City, taken down in 2021 and sued their makers.

source.name: TweakTown: Astro Bot gets an unofficial native PC port

routes.title: Xbox emulation
routes.label: Needs the executable
routes.text: Since launch, open-source projects have started running Xbox Series X|S games on PC, which the console's PC-like x86-64 processor makes easier than PS5 emulation. TomBox, a general Xbox Series runtime, gets an Xbox build of Fortnite to its lobby, though with wrong materials, no audio and nothing playable. Leonida, built only for GTA 6, has translated all 26,503 of the game's graphics shaders for Vulkan. Neither has run GTA 6: the only copy they can work from is the build Cyberleek leaked on November 19, which lacks its executable, and the game's files are reportedly encrypted with a key held in that executable. Cyberleek promises it on Monday, November 23, around 17:00 UTC, while reportedly also saying it "won't run anyway". No public jailbreak exists for the Series X|S, so there's still no way to copy GTA 6 off your own Xbox, and Microsoft's own PC backward compatibility covers only original Xbox and Xbox 360 games.

source.name: RockstarINTEL: Could this major GTA VI leak make it playable on PC?

players.name: AnyPS5 (boykopovar)
players.text: Started in August 2026 by boykopovar, now the most-starred of the three, with more than 57,000 GitHub stars. Rather than emulating, it relinks a PS5 game into a native Windows or Linux program. Its biggest code contributors are oneandonlydean, adriadam10 and MarcZX10.

players.name: AnyPS5's GTA V testers
players.text: Its compatibility list has GTA V at the menus, but testers in its GTA V thread report more: MichonGoddijn231849 played the North Yankton prologue at 27 to 28 fps on a test branch, mrfelek reached the bank scene on the main build on Linux on November 14, LeonardoS11 measured 16.3 fps there on Windows on November 16, and simnJS's AnyKyty branch pairs it with KytyPS5's graphics code.

players.name: chasm
players.text: On November 17 posted more than seven minutes of GTA V's PS5 version driving around Los Santos at a locked 60 fps on a Radeon RX 6750 XT, using AnyPS5 with KytyPS5's graphics code loaded as a DLL. A personal experiment, with graphics bugs.

players.name: KytyPS5 (Nmzik)
players.text: Nmzik revived Kyty, a 2022 emulator by InoriRus, as a PS5-only translation layer in June 2026 and has written almost all of its code since. It gets the most games in-game, 310 on its list. It reached GTA V's menus in July and its prologue at 40 to 60 fps in September, though crashes still stop a full playthrough; TheCruZ is among those chasing the crash.

players.name: SharpEmu (par274)
players.text: An experimental PS5 emulator written in C#, started in March 2026 by par274, who still writes most of it. It has the most games marked fully playable, 47, and GTA V's PS5 version gets in-game.

players.name: Leonida (ItsNotRexed)
players.text: Started on November 20, a day after launch: an open-source project to recompile GTA 6's Xbox Series version so it runs natively on Windows, built from the player's own copy. Within two days it passed 11,000 GitHub stars and 1,800 pull requests opened. All 26,503 of the game's shaders translate to Vulkan, but by its own status page the game doesn't boot yet, and can't until an executable exists.

players.name: TomBox (drycheetah84) and xbox-emulator (omonkeyz)
players.text: TomBox, started on November 17, reimplements the Xbox Series system layer so console games run as Windows programs. Its only tested game, an Xbox build of Fortnite, boots and reaches the lobby with rendering bugs and no audio. omonkeyz's xbox-emulator continues it as a general Xbox Series emulator. Neither has run GTA 6.

players.name: Gezine
players.text: The jailbreak developer closest to GTA 6's firmware. Showed a PS5 on firmware 14.10 jailbroken on October 19 but kept it private, then on November 16 said he had dumped an unnamed game on 14.22. He showed no proof and shared no method, Sony shipped 14.23 the next day, and XDA reports the post was deleted.

players.name: Echo Stretch
players.text: A jailbreak developer and YouTuber. On November 13 he said things "aren't looking good" for dumping games on 14.xx firmware and that he would buy GTA 6 himself. After Gezine's claim he replied that the dump needed no hypervisor exploit, which other reports read differently.

players.name: TheFloW (Andy Nguyen)
players.text: The best-known PS5 hacker and creator of PS5 Linux. In September he quit the PS5 scene after a hypervisor bug he had been keeping private was reported to Sony.

players.name: Jordy (couldbeautism)
players.text: Reported that hypervisor bug to Sony through its HackerOne bug bounty in September, reportedly for $50,000, saying a third person had found it with AI anyway. The scene split over whether reporting it was right.

players.name: ntfargo (Relapse)
players.text: Published Relapse on September 29, a jailbreak for PS5 firmware 7.00 to 13.60. It doesn't reach the 14.23 firmware GTA 6 needs.

players.name: PS5Dev (Byepervisor-Reborn)
players.text: Released a hypervisor exploit for firmware 13.20 and 13.60 on October 12, a base for developers rather than a jailbreak for players. It also stops short of GTA 6's firmware.

players.name: FULU Foundation (Louis Rossmann)
players.text: The right-to-repair nonprofit co-founded by Louis Rossmann put up a $10,000 bounty for bypassing the PS5 hypervisor on current firmware; donations took the pot past $16,000 by July. It's unclaimed.

players.name: Markus "Doom" Gaasedelen (Bliss)
players.text: Showed Bliss in March 2026, a hardware attack on the original Xbox One that glitches its power at boot to run unsigned code. It needs the physical console and specialist tools, there's no consumer version, and it doesn't touch the Xbox Series X|S that GTA 6 runs on.

players.name: Emma Kirkpatrick and Lander Brandt (Collateral Damage)
players.text: Their 2024 exploit takes over the app layer of Xbox Series X|S and Xbox One consoles on some system versions. Its authors say it isn't a jailbreak and can't run pirated or copied games.

players.name: Cyberleek
players.text: An anonymous leaker who posted GTA 6 footage and story spoilers before launch. On November 19 they released about 200 GB of an Xbox build without its executable. Rockstar community researcher Lucas7yoshi says the files are real but from an older build, and that its assets are encrypted with a key held in the missing executable. Cyberleek tied the executable to their crypto token reaching a market cap of $15 million, later reportedly lowered to $6 million, and promised it regardless when a poll closes on Monday, November 23, at 6 PM CET. They have also reportedly said it "won't run anyway".

players.name: deadinside28 (bbport)
players.text: Released bbport on October 1, a native PC port of Bloodborne that started the wave of fan-rebuilt PlayStation games. Players need their own dumped copy.

players.name: AstroHybrid (the Astro Bot port)
players.text: On November 13 became the first PS5 exclusive with a native PC build, relinked by AnyPS5 with KytyPS5's graphics layer and adding DLSS and frame generation. It needs the player's own dump of version 01.019.000, and it's still CPU-limited.

players.name: chiaki-ng
players.text: The open-source Remote Play client for PS4 and PS5, on Windows, Linux, macOS and Steam Deck. With your own console and copy, it's a legitimate way to play GTA 6 on a PC today.

players.name: SmoovPlay
players.text: A free open-source app released in November 2026 that adds AI frame generation to console Remote Play, from 30 fps up to 120, at the cost of extra input delay.

players.name: Veyra
players.text: A Windows video-enhancement tool that applies upscaling and frame generation to a capture-card or Remote Play feed. A Redditor's GTA 6 trailer test took it from 30 to 90 fps, with visible glitches on characters and lighting.

players.name: Rockstar Games and Take-Two
players.text: Launched GTA 6 on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, at 30 fps on every console, PS5 Pro included. No PC version announced; Take-Two's CEO says that news will come from Rockstar, and GamesBeat's sources point to early 2027.

players.name: Sony
players.text: Has tightened the PS5 since the jailbreak wave: from mid-October jailbroken consoles reportedly needed firmware 14.10 to use PSN, an unofficial store selling pirated games shut down after Sony reportedly sent a cease-and-desist, and two security updates followed, 14.22 on November 2 and 14.23 on November 17, which GTA 6 requires.

players.name: Microsoft (Xbox)
players.text: Streams GTA 6 through Xbox Cloud Gaming to Xbox consoles only. Xbox's Matthew Ball said it won't stream to PC.

players.name: Fake GTA 6 PC downloads
players.text: There is no PC version, so every "GTA 6 for PC" download is fake. ESET found them spreading the Vidar password stealer, and Cynet traced one to WARDEN, which steals browser passwords, Steam logins and crypto wallets.

players.name: Fake emulator pages
players.text: Look-alike GitHub pages for AnyPS5 and KytyPS5, and invented "emulators" such as PCSX5, push password-stealing malware. The real emulators are free, open source and download from their own GitHub projects.

players.name: Fake "Cyberleek build" downloads
players.text: Torrents branded as Cyberleek builds have circulated since August with clashing sizes (113, 130 and 145 GB). One 113 GB "ISO" was almost entirely zero padding wrapped around malware, and a gta6_installer.exe was identified as a password and session stealer. Treat any leaked build or launcher as malware until proven otherwise.

timeline.text: ItsNotRexed starts Leonida, an open-source project to recompile GTA 6's Xbox version for PC. By November 22 it has more than 11,000 GitHub stars and has translated all of the game's shaders, but it can't boot the game without the missing executable.
